triage.fix_rationale: The wait budgets (LOBBY_TIMEOUT in aubade.spec.ts, the twin helper in a11y.spec.ts, the shared lobby helper, and the per-test timeout in the Playwright config) are where the limit is set. Raising them, or cutting the work done before the lobby is ready, is the fix.
triage.hypothesis: The Aubade lobby never finished loading within the fixed wait. The "Unlocking the lobby" overlay was still visible after the 20s LOBBY_TIMEOUT, and the 30s per-test timeout then expired. The lobby is a lazy chunk plus WebGL scene on a slow, GPU-less headless runner, so the time limit is too tight for that condition.
